source: ZXNAME0000XZ introduced ZXNAME0001XZ with low-rank joint compression of keys and values. Instead of caching a full key vector and full value vector for every head and token, the hidden state is projected into a compact latent vector from which the content K/V representations are derived.ZXMATH0000XZ
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 引入了具有低秩联合压缩键和值的 ZXNAME0001XZ。隐藏状态不是为每个头和标记缓存完整的键向量和完整的值向量，而是被投影到一个紧凑的潜在向量中，从中导出内容 K/V 表示。ZXMATH0000XZ
